# Live sandbox fixtures

Staged sandbox endpoints only - never production. Copy `env.example` to `env.local`, fill it with sandbox values, and keep it out of git (it is already in `.gitignore`, and the generator will never write it).

## Before any live case runs

1. The ASM-001 connector lock is approved and its path is set in `LIVE_CONNECTORS_LOCK`.
2. The sandbox hosts are on the approved allowlist and the recipients are approved sandbox identities.
3. Credentials come from the environment, never from a tracked file.
4. Logical fixture handles (`cust-a`, `SKU-OK`) are mapped to sandbox IDs through `env.local`.

If the lock is missing every live case is `SKIP_ASM_001`; an unsupported sandbox feature or an unlocked policy is `BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE`. Neither is `PASS`, and neither may be reported as one.

## Identity and data

- Each case creates its own sandbox records with a unique `run_id` and never shares a session with another case.
- Consent is checked per channel and purpose before any outbound message; a denied action needs no provider receipt - the zero-call audit record plus the provider test sink is the oracle.

## Cleanup, receipts and immutability

- Cleanup retires only what the case created, through the supported sandbox APIs.
- Audit records and provider receipts are immutable: never delete a message that was actually sent to pretend it was not, and never remove pre-existing sandbox records.
- Artifacts that cannot be deleted are reported instead of hidden.
- Local run results, receipts and scratch evidence go to `results/`, which is gitignored.
